ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Suspicious ActiveDirectory Enumeration Via AdFind.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects active directory enumeration activity using known AdFind CLI flags

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*lockoutduration.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lockoutthreshold.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lockoutobservationwindow.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*maxpwdage.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*minpwdage.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*minpwdlength.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pwdhistorylength.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pwdproperties.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-sc\\ admincountdmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-sc\\ exchaddresses.*"))
